text.en:
Reorganization of the Information Technology and
Electronic Commerce Council. Section 3 of Executive Order No. 264 is
amended to read as follows:
"Section 3. Membership. The Council shall be
composed of ten (10) members from government and eight (8)
members from the private sector as follows:
President, Republic of the Philippines
Secretary, Department of Trade and
Private Sector Representative
Secretary, Department of Science and
Technology
Secretary, Socio- Economic Planning and
Director General, National Economic
And Development Authority
Secretary, Department of Transportation
And Communications/ National
Telecommunications Commission
-
Secretary, Department of Budget and
Management
Secretary, Department of Education,
Culture and Sports
Secretary, Department of Interior and
Local Government
Managing Director, National Computer
-
Commission on Higher Education
Chairperson
Seven (7) other private sector representatives,
who shall represent the academe,
private industries, and consumer
PGMA Outgoing 027 1 1

groups, directly related to ICT/
Private sector representatives, including the Co-Chairperson shall
be appointed by the Council for a term of not more than three (3) years
each, which may be extended for another three-year period."
Section 8 of Executive Order No. 264 is deleted.

Transfer of Secretariat. Section 9 of Executive
Order No. 264 is amended to read as follows:
"Section 9. Secretariat. A permanent secretariat
shall be constituted to provide technical and administrative
support to the Council. The secretariat shall be based at the
Presidential Management Staff (PMS) and shall be headed by
an Executive Director to be appointed by the President.
Additional technical and administrative staff from members
of the Council may also be detailed or seconded to the
Secretariat as necessary."

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect
immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this
the Year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and One.
GLORIA MACAPAGAL-ARROYO
PMS LIBRARY
By the President:
WALDO Q. FLORES
Senior Deputy Executive Secretary
